baseline: DIRECT_MARKET: race-normalized inverse purchasable pre-race win odds at the preregistered snapshot

learner.data_objective: equal-weight mean of race winner negative log likelihood
learner.fixed_prior: beta_j iid Normal(0,1) in train-standardized feature units
learner.residual: tanh(linear_predictor) for history-eligible horses; exactly 0 for horse_prior_starts=0
learner.centering_parameter_or_rule: NONE_REQUIRED; any common additive residual shift cancels in conditional softmax and no intercept is fitted

features.standardization: train history-eligible rows only; arithmetic mean and population std(ddof=0); zero/nonfinite std fail closed; frozen train transform reused everywhere
features.zero_prior_history: no fabricated values; residual=0; horse retained in denominator and evaluation population

degrees_of_freedom_removed_before_execut: no current-market feature inside residual learner
no uncertainty metric choice: normalized_entropy only
no residual_clip parameter: tanh bounds residual
no L2 lambda/grid: fixed unit-normal coefficient prior
no feature subset search: six-feature policy fixed
required_machine_invariants: uniform market H=1 exactly reproduces market regardless of beta
zero-prior horse residual exactly 0 and remains in race denominator
probabilities positive and race sums exactly one within numerical tolerance
no result/final odds fields in prediction-time feature path
future_evaluation_gate: mean paired race winner-logloss improvement vs DIRECT_MARKET > 0
paired race bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
improvement positive in every preregistered eval month
no systematic market-rank flattening beyond preregistered tolerance
execution_blockers: Race-time Snapshot Gate v5 real Windows/JV-Link forward provenance PASS
externally anchored trial prereg with train/eval periods, source hashes, exact code hashes and stopping rules
